objective: Perform the "TECHNICAL_DESIGN" role for work item "Add CSV export to the reporting dashboard".

input.workItemTitle: Add CSV export to the reporting dashboard
input.workItemDescription: Users on the analytics team need to export the current reporting dashboard view as a CSV file for offline analysis. No specific format or column list has been agreed yet.

prd.summary: This Product Requirements Document (PRD) defines the requirements for adding a CSV export capability to the reporting dashboard, enabling analytics team users to download the data from their current dashboard view for offline analysis.
requirements: The system shall provide a CSV export mechanism within the reporting dashboard.
The export functionality shall be accessible to members of the analytics team.
The CSV export shall contain the data corresponding to the user's current reporting dashboard view.
The exported file shall be generated in CSV format to support offline analysis.

result.summary: Implement a CSV export feature on the reporting dashboard by adding an export action control, retrieving data filtered by the current view's state, serializing the data into standard CSV format, and delivering it as a downloadable file.
decisions: Add an 'Export CSV' button to the reporting dashboard toolbar/header UI controls.
Capture the client's current dashboard filter, pagination, and sorting parameters upon triggering export to query/extract the exact dataset corresponding to the current view.
Implement a CSV generation utility that formats the dataset records according to standard CSV (RFC 4180) specifications, ensuring correct field quoting and character escaping for special characters.
Deliver the generated CSV via an HTTP response with content type 'text/csv' and header 'Content-Disposition: attachment' to initiate an immediate file download in the user's browser.
